component.name: Polyphone
component.summary: Turn any sound into a musical instrument

description.p: Polyphone is a soundfont editor. A soundfont is a single file holding everything a synthesizer needs to play an instrument: the recorded samples, how they are spread across the keyboard and the velocities, and how they are shaped by envelopes, filters and modulators.
Polyphone creates soundfonts from your own recordings, refines existing ones, converts them to other formats and plays them right away with its built-in synthesizer.

ul.li: sf2 (versions 2.01 and 2.04, 24-bit samples) and sf3 files opened and saved, sfz and DLS imported and exported, sfArk archives and GrandOrgue organs imported
Parameters of many samples, instruments or presets edited at once, graphical editors for the key and velocity ranges and for the envelopes
Sample editor with loop points, pitch and tuning estimation and an equalizer, timbre view showing the level of each harmonic on every key
More than 30 tools: automatic loop, creation of missing samples, transposition, chords, organ mixtures, conversion of stereo samples to mono
Built-in synthesizer with reverb and chorus, played with the virtual keyboard, a MIDI keyboard or the computer keyboard, in more than 200 temperaments and scales
MIDI file player with an export to wav, recorder of the sound (wav) or of what is played (MIDI)
Soundfont explorer for browsing a directory, online repository of the soundfonts shared on polyphone.io
Command line for converting files and rendering MIDI files, MCP server letting an AI assistant browse and edit the open soundfonts
